ADVERTISEMENT FOR POST OF JUNIOR RESEARCH FELLOW (JRF)
Applications are invited along with the bio-data as per the attached format and attested copies of certificates
showing qualifications and experience for one post (01) of JRF in the research project entitled “Whole Genome
Based Analysis of Mobile AMR Determinants in Bacterial Pathogens from Fish in North India and their
Relevance to Human Pathogens” granted to Dr. Ravneet Kaur (PI), Department of Zoology and Prof. Neena
Caplash (Co-PI), Department of Biotechnology, Panjab University, Chandigarh.
Essential Qualifications: Masters Degree in Zoology/Biotechnology/Biophysics/Biochemistry/Microbiology with
minimum 55% marks.
Desirable: Candidates with UGC-NET/GATE/ PU Ph.D. Entrance test/other national entrance test conducted by
Government of India
Emoluments: Rs. 31,000/-p.m.+ 18% HRA for those with Maters Degreeand UGC-NET/GATE till the term of
the project as per DBT and/or Panjab University guidelines.
Rs. 25,000/-p.m.+ 18% HRA for those with only Masters Degree till the term of the project as per
DBT and/or Panjab University guidelines.
Interested persons who fulfill the above conditions may send their complete applications to the
undersigned giving details of all educational qualifications, experience, publications. The hard copy of the
application should reach the office of Department of Zoology by 19thApril, 2024. The detail of interview
will be communicated to the shortlisted candidates by mail.
Note: No TA/DA will be provided. The post is purely temporary and commensurate with project. Candidates
should mention their email address and phone number in the bio data.
Sd/-
(Dr Ravneet Kaur)
Principal Investigator
Department of Zoology
Panjab University, Chandigarh
